items.information: Welcome to Beginner & Blind Joburg 2025! This competition focuses on blindfolded events on day 1 and the beginner friendly events on day 2. As inscrições deverão ser pagas **antecipadamente** via PIX: Associação Na Mochila 53.047.549/0001-06 Enviar o comprovante do pagamento, junto com o nome do competidor, para o email: [bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org). Only sign up if you are sure you will participate. In case of withdrawal, please contact the delegate ([bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org)). Entries must be paid **in advance** via PIX: Associação Na Mochila 53.047.549/0001-06 Send proof of payment, along with the competitor's name, to the email: [bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:bdamacena@worldcubeassociation.org). Registration will only be confirmed on the WCA website **after confirmation of payment**. Entries on the day of the competition will **only be open for 3x3x3**. Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.

items.information: * It is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot. * Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. items.information: ##### **This is not a normal competition with common events like 3x3 and 2x2. This competition features "quiet" and less common events. For a more normal competition experience, check out the [many other competitions happening in Texas](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=USA&search=Texas&state=present&year=all+years&from_date=&to_date=&delegate=&show_registration_status=on&display=list), including [DFW Qualifier 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWQualifier2025), happening the day after in Arlington.** - Please review the [Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWQuietQualifier2025#57552-competitor-information) tab before the competition. - Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition. Please note that the [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWQuietQualifier2025#competition-schedule) is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule. The University of Texas at Dallas and the Comet Cubing Club will not take custodial responsibility of minors while participating in DFW Quiet Qualifier 2025. Custodial responsibility will remain with teachers K-12, parents, legal guardians, and chaperones. This competition is supported by Southern Cubing LLC. Este evento emocionante y lleno de velocidad se llevará a cabo en la ciudad de Tepic los días sábado 17 y domingo 18 de mayo de 2025. El Mololoa Open 2025 reunirá a cuberos de todo el estado de Nayarit y más allá, brindándoles la oportunidad de mostrar su destreza y competir en una variedad de eventos. Tanto si eres un principiante como un profesional experimentado, este torneo ofrece una oportunidad para que todos participen y se diviertan. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial del Cubo. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia. ###### English Welcome to Mololoa Open 2025, another competition in the beautiful state of **Nayarit**! This exciting and high-speed event will take place in the city of Tepic on Saturday, May 17, and Sunday, May 18, 2025. Mololoa Open 2025 will bring together cubers from across the state of Nayarit and beyond, providing them with the opportunity to showcase their skills and compete in a variety of events. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced professional, this tournament offers a chance for everyone to participate and have fun. This competition is recognized as an official event by the World Cube Association. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.
